video.title: FULLTANK WEDNESDAY: Stop Explaining Yourself
video.description:
No matter how much good you do, how kind you are, or how hard you try, there will always be critics who are determined to misunderstand you. When you stop wasting your energy defending yourself against every baseless accusation, you free yourself to stay focused on the path God has called you to walk. 

#FULLTANKwithBroBo #FULLTANKwithBroBo2026 #BoSanchez #StopExplainingYourself #StopPeoplePleasing #GodKnowsMyHeart #FaithInAction #SpiritualMaturity #TrulyRichMindset #StayFaithful #Grace

comments.author: @randyvidal1057
comments.text:
Lord Jesus Christ, open our ears to hear the good news of your kingdom and set our hearts free to love and serve you joyfully. May nothing keep us from following you with all my heart, mind, and strength. For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways. This is the very word of the Lord. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts. Isaiah 55:8–9, NEB

Lord our God, we thank you for allowing us to come to you and to stand before your face. We thank you for helping us throughout our life on earth, for strengthening our faith in you and our trust in all you do. Bless us and give us courage. May your light shine out among the peoples so that they recognize your will. May your light shine out so that your name may be praised and we can rejoice in the new time you give us. For you will be at work and you will accomplish it. Even when we do not know what will become of our time, you know what our time needs, and you will carry out your will. You will let your name be honored. You will bring your kingdom, and you will change everything for the good. In Jesus Christ Name. Amen.
